title: reference manifest
description: data/references/<tier>/<dataset_id>/manifest.json: what a reference is and the checksum of each item's text. Written by evh reference-create (a reference made by the harness) or evh reference-manifest (one built by a fetch script). Committed even when the text is not redistributed: validate's V16 checks the text present against it.

dataset_id.description: The dataset it is a reference for: the directory's name, unless the dataset has a second reference of the tier under a name of its own (gold/ag_news_200_adj1 for ag_news_200).

items_sha256.description: {item_id: sha256 of the item's reference text, as stored}.

caveat.description: What the tier is, to show beside any number scored against it.

source.description: How to rebuild the text, for a reference built outside the harness: the script that fetches it (examples/<example>/fetch.py).

redistributed.description: false: the text is not in the repository (its licence, or the project's choice); the manifest proves a rebuilt copy is the same.

authored_by.description: The config whose run or model wrote it (silver).

authored_with.description: The adapter that wrote it: a reference written by other code than the arms use is a different measurement.

system_under_test.description: The author's identity record, as a run writes it.

from_run.description: The run it was made from (reference-create --from-run).

from_outcomes.description: Made from what production recorded afterwards (evh reference-from-outcomes, RFC-019): the capture, the mapping and its hash, and how many items each rule outcome took.
